kind: optimistic initial-monster reachability with removables passable, water/fire ignored, both teleports connected
scope: Original level; static geometry and source inspection supplement the native-verified partial route. Not a complete impossibility proof.
modelAssumptions: Start from the nine original non-block creatures; follow every orthogonal edge allowed by the stated terrain exclusions and thin-wall direction masks, regardless of creature AI.
For actor tiles (top id >= 64), use bottom terrain; otherwise use top terrain. Treat other objects as passable and ignore fire/water hazards. This deliberately admits extra ordinary paths.
Connect both original teleport positions in both directions; forbid cells whose bottom layer is CloneMachine.
Sockets remain closed while the final chip is uncollected. This pre-final-chip reachability result is not extended to states after that chip is collected.
Both original cloners produce blocks; this graph addresses ordinary travel of the original monsters, not block transport or arbitrary scheduler effects.
limitation: The graph excludes the listed gate positions and both teleports for ordinary monster travel under these assumptions; it is not an exhaustive dynamic-state or engine-glitch analysis.
